correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 6^6=46656 strictly complete labeled 3x3 preference profiles, all six perfect matchings each, with blocking-pair test and exact one-based rank sum/max. Reproduced E=R 40056, proper E subset R 5400, proper R subset E 1200, no nonnested/disjoint cases, and stable-match multiplicities 34080/11484/1092. Reconstructed stated 4x4 profile separately over all 24 matchings; only (B,A,C,D) with (sum,max)=(15,3) and (C,A,B,D) with (13,4) stable, proving conflict. The assigned verifier covers n=2; n=1 immediate. Finite exhaustiveness is legitimate because 6^6 is all of n=3 domain, not a general-n claim.
